public_claims.wording: A real NOAA/NGS RINEX observation traversed the recorded-real GPS chain and remained fail-closed when live attestation and multisource corroboration were not proven.
A public recorded GNSS I/Q dataset was processed through GNSS-SDR and traversed the recorded-real RF chain while remaining bounded to recorded evidence.
Stored recorded-real GPS artifacts can be re-ingested through the current canonical world, domain and reality-authenticity contracts without claim promotion.
The first-world periphery, domain bridges, scientific layers and proof layers do not gain decision or action authority; decision authority remains KX108_ONLY.

known_limits: Recorded evidence is not live sensor attestation.
Different source identifiers do not by themselves prove causal independence.
Cross-modal agreement does not prove truth or causality.
Scientific possibility and impossibility remain bounded to declared models and evidence.
Vision observations remain candidate representations and do not reconstruct hidden reality as truth.
GPS hostile RF work remains partial and does not support spoofing-resistance claims.
F23 Monde UI is outside this repository release chain and is not part of this release candidate.
